note: Indicative Pakistani market rates (September 2026), built up from published 2026 material prices for cement (~PKR 1,500/50kg bag), Grade-60 steel (~PKR 280-300/kg), sand (~PKR 55-70/cft), crush/bajri (~PKR 110-150/cft), bricks (~PKR 14-17/unit), plaster (~PKR 64-125/sqft incl. labour), paint (~PKR 25-70/sqft incl. labour), wooden doors with frame (~PKR 25,000-30,000/door mid-range) and aluminium windows (~PKR 1,500-2,500/sqft), combined with standard nominal-mix (cement:sand:aggregate) and dry-volume-factor quantities plus typical site labour allowances. All rates are all-inclusive (material + labour) approximations for preliminary budgeting ONLY - they are NOT a live price feed, are NOT city/supplier-specific (Karachi/Lahore/Islamabad and rural rates can differ by 10-30%), and MUST be overridden with your own current local quotations before the cost estimate is relied upon. Every rate below is per canonical metric unit (m3/m2/kg) even when the app is displaying quantities in FPS (cft/sqft) - the on-screen rate is converted automatically so totals match either way. The cement/sand/aggregate breakdown shown in the MTO (Step 4) for every concrete/mortar pour is a procurement-reference quantity only - it is already included in that pour's composite rate below (e.g. FTG-CONC-01) and deliberately has NO rate-book entry of its own, so it is never double-counted in the BOQ. RATE BASES: RCC rates (footings, columns, beams, slabs, stairs, lintels) are priced for M20 and PCC rates (PCC-01, GF-PCC-01) for M10; choosing another concrete grade in Step 1 adjusts these rates automatically by the difference in cement/sand/aggregate cost (see engineering/rules.py). Masonry is split into MAS-01 units (material only, ~PKR 14-17/brick), MAS-02 mortar (material only) and MAS-03 laying labour (~1 mason-day + ~1.5 helper-days per m3 at indicative daily wages). MEP lines (ELEC-01, PLUMB-01, KITCH-01, WSD-01) are indicative parametric allowances built from published 2026 Pakistani fitting/wiring price ranges (e.g. ~PKR 120,000-250,000 for complete electrical fittings of a 5-marla house, plus wiring and conduits) - replace them with actual quotations. FDN-MAS-01 (foundation brickwork) is a composite rate: ~408 bricks + ~0.23 m3 1:6 mortar + laying labour per m3. Backfill, plinth filling, soling, staircase, lintel, ceiling and roof-treatment rates are indicative composite rates on the same basis as the rest of this book.
